scope: human CHRM4 positive allosteric modulator functional optimization

anchor_engine.expansion_policy: current DeltaSAR predicted low and high endpoint among unmeasured anchor-pool molecules

required_anchor_assays: human M4 PAM concentration-response at fixed orthosteric probe and readout
human M2 counter-screen under matched probe/readout

structural_role: pose, compatibility, and mechanistic audit only; no static affinity as PAM efficacy label

claim_boundary: No SOTA or confirmed PAM claim without untouched functional campaign or prospective experiment
